note: NO TOOLS were available in this invocation, so scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/pepper.test.ts and pepper.test-spec.json could NOT be written to disk — the full source is returned in testSource verbatim and must be saved by the orchestrator. Also flagging a CONTRADICTION inside the packet itself: the 'OVERRIDE FILE SHAPE' section states the slots are Block[] arrays while the 'Harness boilerplate' section states each slot is a CharacterSkills carrying its own blocks[] and that ov.blocks is a no-op. The test resolves BOTH shapes at runtime rather than guessing.

spec.assertion: Structural: skill1 carries a block with trigger.kind 'lastBullet', target.kind 'alliesLowestHp' count 1, and a 'heal' effect. RED under the nearest-wrong models: target self / allies-all, trigger shotFired or interval, or the heal dropped entirely as 'defensive'.

No StatKey exists for incoming healing, so the stat is unmodelable; the 5-stack CAP is load-bearing for the burst gate and is asserted to exist (maxStacks:5 or a resource max:5). RED if modeled as a single non-stacking buff, which makes the burst's max-stack branch either unreachable or always-on.

Pepper reloads >= 5 times in 180 s (max stacks reachable) and every consecutive magazine gap is < 15 s (stacks never lapse between refreshes). RED if the SG cadence is slower than the 15 s window, which would mean Refresh Heart genuinely decays and the burst gate is only intermittently satisfiable.
Clearing skill2 strictly reduces pepper's total AND her damage-event count. RED under a debuff-only model (the ATK-down is inert at scope, so a debuff-only skill2 leaves the total untouched).

The rider's damage events sit in a bucket that goes to exactly zero when skill2 is cleared (skill1 carries no damage, so that bucket is pure skill2), that bucket is not her most-populous bucket, and every one of its events has rangeApplied false and core rate 0. RED if the 160% is folded into a normalAttackPct/extraHit rider (which cores and takes the +30% range bonus) or authored core:true.

Skill-bucket procs are evenly spaced (gap spread < 0.5 s) and at least one proc sits > 0.5 s away from every reload boundary. RED under the nearest-wrong lastBullet keying (which frame-locks every proc to a magazine boundary). The PERIOD itself is deliberately not asserted — it is not in the kit text and must be a flagged datamined value.
No buffApply with a negative value targets any ally slug in the comp. RED if the enemy ATK-down is mis-scoped onto the caster/allies or inverted into an ally buff.

Pepper casts her own burst at least once and clearing the burst slot strictly reduces her total. RED if the nuke is dropped or if the Burst I contention with liter means she never casts (a fixture finding, asserted explicitly rather than assumed).

Every burst-bucket damage event has fbMajorApplied false, rangeApplied false and core rate 0. RED under the nearest-wrong fullBurstEnter keying, which would collect the +50% Full Burst major and the entry auras a burst cast resolves before.

it.skip — no effect kind increments an existing ally buff's stack counter, and no event exposes a stack bump distinguishable from a fresh buffApply. Pepper's signature team mechanic; belongs in unmodeled.burst.
it.skip — no HP pool and no heal/recovery event kind on the tap, so neither the max-stack gate nor the heal has a readable channel in this harness.

fixtures: controlComp('pepper', true) only — liter(B1) / crown(B2) / pepper / helm(B3), 3 hoisted 180 s runs (stock, skill2 cleared, burst cleared). The fixed B3 is KEPT because without a stage-3 caster the chain never reaches Full Burst, and both the rotation and the FB-exemption assertion need real Full Bursts. TWO fixture risks are asserted rather than assumed: (1) pepper is herself a Burst I and contends with liter for the B1 slot every rotation, so 'pepper casts her own burst' is its own test — a RED there means the burst lines need a custom comp, not that the burst model is wrong; (2) the deterministic 'lowest remaining HP' stand-in resolves to the leftmost ally, which is not the fixture's recovery-keyed consumer, so the heal's tandem channel is unreachable here. Counterfactuals never assert teammate byte-identity, because removing a flatDamage line also removes its skill-damage gauge impact and can shift the whole team's full-burst timing.
gaps: it.skip — burst 'Increases stack count of stackable buffs by 1': no schema primitive exists for incrementing an existing buff's stack counter on allies (nearest kinds are `buff` with maxStacks and `resource`, neither of which reaches another unit's live stack pool). Pepper's signature mechanic; must be recorded in unmodeled.burst.

it.skip — burst 'when Refresh Heart is at max stacks, restore 27.22% of Max HP to all allies': v1 has no HP pool and the event tap exposes no heal/recovery kind, so neither the gate nor the payload is observable.

it.skip — skill1 heal -> teammate `recovery` trigger tandem: with no HP pool, 'lowest HP percentage' resolves to the leftmost ally, which in controlComp is not a recovery-keyed unit; needs a purpose-built comp seating one leftmost.

NOT TESTED (outside the input domain, ALWAYS-flag): skill2's interval PERIOD — the kit prose gives skill2 no activation clause and no cooldown, so any period is a datamined/invented value. The test pins the trigger SHAPE (steady cadence, not magazine-locked) and deliberately never asserts the number.

NOT TESTED (ALWAYS-flag): the SG cadence tuple (pulls/sec) and hitsPerShot=10 pellet split-vs-merge — both are datamine-unreliable and drive the lastBullet frequency that Refresh Heart's whole ramp depends on. The 15 s non-lapse test is the one place this leaks into a pass/fail, and is flagged as such in the file.
